glossary.note: 钢铁雄心4 术语对照表。翻译时严格遵守，保证全站译名一致。

style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

List of La Resistance Historical Operations
Cost
Operation Gunnerside
500 Infantry Equipment and 50 Support Equipment

The Germans have begun producing Heavy Water in a plant in Norway, possibly connected to a program to develop an atomic bomb. Even if the Heavy Water produced is not enough to enable them to build such a weapon, it would no doubt greatly help them in their research.
Get event "Operation Gunnerside succeeds", Germany: get event "Telemark Heavy Water Plant destroyed"
Operation Biting

It appears that the enemy is ahead of us in the development of radar. We have identified an enemy radar installation in a vulnerable location that we believe could be taken by a sufficiently determined assault by a small force to acquire more intelligence.
Get event "Operation Biting succeeds", Germany: get event "Enemy Commando raid captures radar equipment"
Unternehmen Rösselsprung
2000 Infantry Equipment

Yugoslav partisans have grown in strength and are making increasingly bold advances. In many areas, they effectively control the countryside, blocking roads and operating with impunity. The key to this is the Partisan leader Tito, who has been coordinating and controlling these operations. To take him out would deal a serious blow to the resistance in these areas.
75% chance of getting event "Unternehmen Rösselsprung fails", 25% chance of getting event "Unternehmen Rösselsprung succeeds"
Rescue Benito Mussolini

After being deposed by [ITA.GetLeader], Mussolini has been put under arrest in a small hotel in the Apennine mountains. We have a small window to rescue him and return him to our lines, where he would no doubt help in administering the Italian territories after our victory.
25% chance of getting event "Rescue attempt fails", 75% chance of getting event "Mussolini Rescued"
List of No Step Back Historical Operations
Raid Trotsky’s Villa
50 Infantry Equipment and 50 Support Equipment
Trotsky has been holed up in his villa, corresponding with other party members to plot against the Soviet state. We can send a small team to attack his house and put this to an end.
Get event "The Assassination of Lev Trotsky"
Get event "Trotsky Survives Assassination Attempt"
Subtle Assassination
A direct assault is unlikely to succeed. We should use more subtle means to get close to Trotsky, and then strike him down while his back is turned.
Infiltrate Atomic Program
Our nuclear weapons program is behind other countries. We should plan an operation to infiltrate foreign atomic weapons programs and acquire vital blueprints and data.
Get event "Agent returns with nuclear secrets"

"Resistance Contacts"

Instigate Workers Revolution in Britain
5000 Infantry Equipment and 500 Support Equipment

Across the Channel lies the birthplace of the industrial revolution, and with it, the home of modern capitalism. We can not allow this place to become the springboard for a counter-revolutionary enemy.
Starts resistance in Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland
Instigate Workers Revolution in Italy

The first country to fall to fascism was Italy. As a result, the ideology is firmly entrenched in Italy. Our world-views can not peacefully coexist. They know this as well as we do, and will no doubt prepare to act. So must we.
